coverage: Selected public municipal culture and community programmes, with strong city-library concentration and 29 dated English-language museum tours representing one programme. The public calendar returned a capped view of 600 objects, not verified complete pagination. No Telegram imports. October 29 activities have elapsed; later November relies on explicitly listed recurring programmes. Venue points represent named buildings or campuses, not surveyed entrances. Three initially published records were moved to held-for-recheck because birth-year audience metadata has unresolved eligibility semantics; no age threshold is inferred.
